top_signals.title: Scammer loses $4.8M stored on tampered Ledgers: Asia Express
top_signals.summary: A scammer reportedly lost $4.8M of stolen money after storing the funds on tampered Ledgers. Bitcoin and Ether ETFs launch trading in Thailand and South Korea blocks 27 exchanges.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Harvard Fund Hits Record $68 Billion After 27% Return
top_signals.summary: Harvard University’s endowment jumped to a record $68 billion as successful bets on equities and venture capital including SpaceX holdings helped the richest US college weather an unprecedented pressure campaign from President Donald Trump.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
